UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user preferences, favorites, and playback settings synced to Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this preferences document.

displayName.description: Optional display name for account personalization.

reducedMotion.description: Whether subtle animations and transitions are minimized.

arabicFontScale.description: Relative font scale multiplier for Quranic Arabic text.

autoplayNext.description: Whether playback automatically advances to the next queued track.

ambientVolume.description: Independent volume level (0.0 to 1.0) for ambient soundscape.

preferredAudioSourceCode.description: Optional preferred audio CDN source code.

favoriteReciterIds.description: Bounded list of saved reciter IDs.

favoriteTrackIds.description: Bounded list of saved track IDs.

savedCollectionIds.description: Bounded list of saved collection IDs.

isDemoPremium.description: Demo preview entitlement flag when external billing is not configured.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CustomPlaylist.title: CustomPlaylist
CustomPlaylist.description: User-authored custom recitation playlist with ordered track IDs.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the playlist owner.

trackIds.description: Ordered bounded list of track IDs in this playlist.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on modification via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ListeningEvent.title: ListeningEvent
ListeningEvent.description: Recorded real playback session event used for Recently Played and Listening Insights.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this listening event.

trackId.description: Identifier of the audio track played.

durationListenedSec.description: Actual seconds listened during this playback event.

lastPositionMs.description: Last playback position in milliseconds for Continue Listening.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user preferences, favorites, and saved collections isolated by Firebase UID.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: User-owned custom playlists isolated under the user's document.

/users/{userId}/listening_events/{eventI.description: User-owned recorded playback analytics events isolated under the user's document.
